projects.title: Table Thirteen
projects.label: Restaurant ordering
projects.summary: A restaurant menu and table ordering experience, redesigned around the guest.
projects.description:
A menu made for ordering at the table. Guests can search by name or ingredient, filter for vegan or spicy dishes, sort by price and build an order as they browse.

The order stays in view at the bottom of the screen, with service call and order history within reach.

background.alt: Table Thirteen restaurant menu with categories, filters and an order bar

details.label: Menu
details.value: Categories, search, dietary filters and sorting

details.label: Ordering
details.value: Live order total, order history and call service

projects.title: Aspect Floral Studio
projects.label: Online flower shop
projects.summary: A floral shop with a softer visual identity and a clearer path to the right bouquet.
projects.description:
A flower shop website built around warm photography and simple choices. Visitors can shop bouquets, save favourites and read the story behind the studio.

The checkout runs as a demo, so no payments are taken on the preview site.

background.alt: Aspect Floral Studio home page with a bouquet of pink roses

details.label: Shopping
details.value: Collections, favourites, bag and demo checkout

projects.title: Acres
projects.label: Ceramics studio
projects.summary: A small-batch ceramics store with a bold look and an easy way to browse each piece.
projects.description:
A website for an independent ceramics studio. Product pages sit alongside the studio story, product reviews and a short Q&A.

Visitors add pieces to a shopping bag and send the studio an inquiry about the ones they chose.

background.alt: Acres ceramics studio home page with speckled blue and white bowls

details.label: Shopping
details.value: Product pages, colour choices and an inquiry bag
